name: supplytrack-web
description: Dev dependency for the headless harness only (web/tests/headless-2025.js). The page itself ships no bundler and no framework. Deliberately no "type": "module": xlsxio.js's require() of the vendored UMD ExcelJS build (web/vendor/exceljs.min.js) needs it resolved as CommonJS, which "type": "module" breaks (require() then returns {}, not the library) - see report-tests.js if this is ever revisited.
